a claw, VS. xii, 4
a wooden implement formed like a claw or hook (for lifting an iron pot or pan from the fire), Br.; Lāṭy.

a: शफः --फं — [शम्-अच् पृषो˚ पस्यफः] 1 A hoof. --2 The root of a tree. --Comp. --ऊरुः f. a woman having thighs resembling the two divisions of a cow's hoof; see P. IV. 1. 70.

a carp or kind of large fish (that preys on other fish), Kathās. cxxiii, 10
a: शफरः — (री f.) [शफं राति रा-क Tv.] A kind of small glittering fish; मोघीकर्तुं चटुलशफरोद्वर्तनप्रेक्षितानि Me. 40; Śi. 8. 24; Ku. 4. 39. --Comp. --अधिपः the fish called Ilīśa.

m: शफर—रूप n. the form of a carp or large fish, BhP.

शफरुक m. a box, box-like receptacle, pot, Hcar.
1. शफ—वत् (शफ-), mfn. possessing hoofs or claws (n. a hoofed animal), ib.
